default_program_records.label: unicode.utf8
default_program_records.reason: MLKit keeps a region and a frame for every step of a loop whose tail call stands inside the let that makes a string, although --preserve_tail_calls is on (docs/bugreport/mlkit/preserve-tail-calls): the round trip of every scalar value takes 7.1 GB, and the test fails with "Cannot allocate memory" where the machine cannot give it that (under ulimit -v 14000000); it passes where it can, and passes in 3.5 MB built with -no_ri
